premise: I trusted my daughter with $150,000 from my late husband’s medical‑malpractice settlement, granting her power of attorney after my stroke; she forged a gift letter, drained the funds, and bought a $350,000 beach condo. I recovered a Ring doorbell video of her admitting the scheme, won the condo back plus damages, and now operate “Stroke of Betrayal Vacation Rentals” — she scrubs toilets in a shirt that says “Flushed My Trust,” and every booking confirmation prints her fraud judgment.
